market_summary: Markedet roterede ind i tech tirsdag foran onsdagens Nvidia-regnskab, med faldende olie og renter som medvind, mens stigende Treasury-renter fortsat presser rentefølsomme navne som DHI, hvor en ny mold-retssagsrisiko også er dukket op. Porteføljen har ingen brudte stops i dag, men Industrials (TDG+MMM) udgør 32.8% af eksponeringen, så ingen nye Industrials-køb tilføjes; med kun ca. $2.990 ledig købskraft over det påkrævede $2.500-kontantminimum og ingen overbevisende nye setups blandt de resterende BULL-kandidater (COIN/ON stærkt strakte eller ubekræftede bunde), holdes alle 14 positioner uændret uden nye køb.

decisions.name: Nasdaq, Inc.
decisions.reasoning: Overkøbt (RSI 75.3) men kursmålet ($108) er ikke nået, og 23-timers handel-lanceringen samt LeveL Markets-diversificeringen holder den strukturelle case intakt. Ingen brud på stop — behold.
bull: Launching 23-hour trading in December to capture overseas order flow, plus the LeveL Markets acquisition is diversifying revenue into fintech/compliance software.
Price trend is strong, sitting near 52-week highs above both moving averages.
bear: RSI 75.3 / Stochastic 89.3 show the stock is technically overbought after its run.
Growth initiatives (23-hour trading) won't show revenue impact until later this year, limiting near-term catalysts.

investment_plan.thesis: Bekræftet teknisk vending + rekordstærkt IPO-halvår og AI-platform-adoption forbliver intakt.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Trailing stop ved $95.06 (2x ATR fra nuværende niveau). Sælg ved close under stop eller markant eskalering af perpetual-futures-konkurrencetrussel.

decisions.name: TransDigm Group
decisions.reasoning: Fortsat i teknisk downtrend, men uden selskabsspecifik skuffelse — Boeing 737 MAX-rampen forbliver en positiv read-through. Sammen med MMM udgør denne position 32.8% Industrials-eksponering, som overvåges nøje, men stop er ikke ramt endnu.
bull: Boeing's 737 MAX production ramp is a direct read-through positive for TDG as a key aerospace aftermarket/OEM parts supplier.
Oversold technically (RSI 34.2, Stoch 12.6) after a recent pullback.
bear: Currently in a downtrend, trading below both the 50- and 200-day averages.
No company-specific catalyst this week beyond broader sector context; high per-share price means large dollar swings (ATR ~$28).

investment_plan.thesis: Makro-/oliedrevet industriselloff, ikke selskabsspecifik svaghed - høj-margin aerospace-eftermarkedsforretning forbliver intakt.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $1166.19 (2x ATR). Sælg ved selskabsspecifik indtjeningsskuffelse eller brud på Zacks-opgraderingens antagelser.

decisions.name: Marvell Technology
decisions.reasoning: AI-drevet rally fortsætter med frisk kursmålshævning fra Susquehanna, men egne regnskaber er en nært forestående binær begivenhed — hold uændret indtil earnings er afklaret.
bull: Strong AI-driven rally (+38% over 20 days) with Susquehanna just raising its price target to $265 on AI opportunity momentum.
Broad semiconductor sector strength ahead of Nvidia's earnings is providing a positive read-across tailwind.
bear: The move has been very fast (+11% in five days alone), raising valuation and pullback risk.
Marvell's own upcoming earnings are a binary event that could reverse the rally quickly if results disappoint.

investment_plan.thesis: Sektor-bred sympati-selloff i chip-komplekset giver dyb oversolgt entry i en langsigtet intakt AI-silicon-vækstcase, nu bekræftet af en konkret Google-designvinding.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $162.53 (2x ATR). Sælg hvis Kina-hukommelseskonkurrencen viser sig strukturel, eller ved selskabsspecifik indtjeningsskuffelse.

decisions.name: 3M Company
decisions.reasoning: Stabile tekniske forhold nær 52-ugers højder; Industrial/Transportation-styrke opvejer fortsat svag Consumer-efterspørgsel. Ingen brud på tesen.
bull: Price sits near 52-week highs, above both the 50- and 200-day averages, with Industrial/Transportation segment strength offsetting weakness elsewhere.
Technicals are calm and stable, with no signs of a breakdown.
bear: The Consumer segment continues to face soft retail demand and muted hardline spending.
Sector read-across (Honeywell's Process Automation weakness) points to broader softness in industrial-automation demand that could eventually reach 3M.

investment_plan.thesis: Ægte beat-and-raise-regnskab plus nyt Azure-partnerskab holder det tekniske billede bullish.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $167.21 (2x ATR). Sælg ved PFAS/høreværns-retssagsrisiko eskalerer yderligere, eller tilbagegang i organisk vækst/guidance.

decisions.name: Vertex Pharmaceuticals
decisions.reasoning: Nyt all-time high på en reel ny vækstmotor ud over CF-franchisen, men RSI 74 / Stoch 96 er ekstremt overkøbt — ingen ny handling, blot overvågning af momentum.
bull: Just hit an all-time high, with Wall Street decidedly bullish on a new growth engine beyond the core cystic-fibrosis franchise.
Framed as a defensive inflation-hedge name, adding a distinct positive narrative on top of the growth story.
bear: RSI 74.0 / Stochastic 96.2 show the stock is extremely overbought, priced for perfection at all-time highs.
Any disappointment on the new growth engine would hit hard given the stretched valuation and sentiment.

investment_plan.thesis: Dybt oversolgt i en teknisk intakt opadgående trend, med Crinetics-opkøb som signal om offensiv pipeline-udvidelse - tesen er siden bekræftet af hævet guidance og gennemført tilbagekøb, så kursmålet hæves.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $448.95 (2x ATR). Sælg hvis Crinetics-opkøbet viser overbetaling/integrationsproblemer, eller ved pipeline-skuffelse.

decisions.name: Flex Ltd.
decisions.reasoning: AI-infrastruktur-væksttema forbliver strukturelt intakt over 200-dages gennemsnittet, og dagens +2.4% bounce følger en skarp pullback — ingen fundamental svækkelse.
bull: AI infrastructure buildout (power and cooling investments) is a structural tailwind, and price remains well above its 200-day average.
Today's +2.4% bounce follows a sharp five-day pullback, hinting at stabilization.
bear: Sharp recent pullback (-9.1% in five days) has pushed price 16% below its 50-day average, real near-term technical damage.
Competitive intensity in AI infrastructure manufacturing (vs. Celestica) could pressure margins.

investment_plan.thesis: Beat-and-raise-regnskab ignoreret af markedet i en bred tech-selloff giver en dybt oversolgt entry.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $85.68 (2x ATR). Sælg ved selskabsspecifik indtjeningsskuffelse eller fortsat makrodrevet selloff uden bundtegn.

decisions.name: Amazon.com, Inc.
decisions.reasoning: Opadgående trend intakt over begge glidende gennemsnit, men momentum flader ud uden frisk selskabsspecifik katalysator. Behold, stop ikke ramt.
bull: Price remains above both the 50- and 200-day averages, and broader tech-sector rotation is a supportive backdrop.
Short-term technicals (Stochastic 17.4) suggest room to bounce within the uptrend.
bear: Momentum is decelerating sharply — a strong 13% twenty-day gain has flattened to just 0.6% over the last five days.
No fresh Amazon-specific catalyst this week; news flow is dominated by peers and broad market context.

investment_plan.thesis: Regnskabsdrevet breakout bekræfter AI-monetisering på tværs af cloud og retail.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $253.07 (2x ATR, lige under dagens breakout-niveau). Sælg ved skarp reversal uden opfølgning eller selskabsspecifik skuffelse.

decisions.name: Walt Disney Company (The)
decisions.reasoning: Ny CEO's omkostningsdisciplin og strategiske satsninger holder momentum stærkt, men RSI 73.4/Stoch 93.7 er overkøbt og Netflix tager markedsandele i streaming-narrativet. Behold uændret.
bull: Strong price momentum (+12.5% over 20 days) near 52-week highs, with the new CEO announcing cost cuts alongside strategic bets.
Early-retirement offers to veteran executives signal real cost discipline taking hold.
bear: RSI 73.4 / Stochastic 93.7 show the stock is technically overbought and due for a pause.
Wolfe Research highlighted Netflix pulling ahead in the streaming comparison, a competitive headwind.

investment_plan.thesis: NFL-indholdsaftalen og bundle-strategien virker synligt - faldende churn, stigende abonnentvækst og analytiker-kursmålsforhøjelser efter femte regnskabsbeat i træk.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $99.98 (2x ATR). Sælg hvis streaming-bundle-økonomien eller NFL-indholdsomkostninger eroderer marginforbedringen, eller ved skarpt reversal uden opfølgning.

decisions.name: Loews Corporation
decisions.reasoning: Solidt Q2 med CNA-beat, men markedet reagerede afdæmpet og forsikringsmarginer er svage. Lille position, stop ikke ramt — behold.
bull: Q2 profit rose on diversified insurance/pipeline/hospitality contributions, and subsidiary CNA Financial beat estimates.
Oversold (RSI 24.0) within a still-intact longer-term uptrend (above its 200-day average).
bear: Insurance underwriting margins are softening even as other segments pick up the slack.
The market gave the stock only a muted reaction to good results, suggesting limited near-term catalyst.

investment_plan.thesis: Solidt Q2-beat i hoteller/rørledninger og en ekstremt oversolgt RSI (9.2) relativt til det milde 5-dages fald peger på en teknisk bounce-mulighed i et fundamentalt sundt konglomerat.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $108.22 (2x ATR). Sælg hvis CNA-forsikringsunderwriting svækkes markant yderligere, eller ved brud på RSI-bounce-tesen uden opfølgning.

decisions.name: Keysight Technologies
decisions.reasoning: Bredt baseret regnskabsbeat bekræftet af dagens +3% bounce efter pullback — tesen om AI-infrastruktur-drevet vækst er styrket, ikke svækket.
bull: Q2 revenue and EPS beat expectations on broad-based demand strength, with a positive market reaction.
Price remains well above its 200-day average despite the recent pullback, and today's +3% move confirms renewed buying interest.
bear: Pulled back roughly 6% over the past five days before today's bounce, showing some near-term volatility.
Test-and-measurement demand can be cyclical if broader capex slows.

investment_plan.thesis: Genuin fundamental forbedring (beat-and-raise på AI-infrastruktur) er maskeret af bred tech-sektor-selloff, hvilket giver et sentimentdrevet, ikke selskabsspecifikt, indgangspunkt.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $289.67 (2x ATR). Sælg ved bekræftet forværring af leveringsbegrænsninger eller selskabsspecifik indtjeningsskuffelse.

decisions.name: D. R. Horton
decisions.reasoning: Ny fremvoksende mold-retssagsrisiko og stigende renter presser i dag verdikten til BEAR, men det oprindelige tese-forbehold om rentemodvind var allerede kendt ved entry, og stop ($142.59) er ikke i nærheden. Behold men overvåg tæt — sælg ved yderligere eskalering.
bull: Technicals are fairly neutral, with price hugging both the 50- and 200-day averages rather than breaking down.
No acute near-term catalyst has moved the stock either way.
bear: Emerging mold-related litigation against homebuilders (DHI and Lennar named) adds a new legal/cost risk.
Rising Treasury yields are a renewed headwind for rate-sensitive homebuilder demand and financing costs.

investment_plan.thesis: Notabelt Berkshire-køb (Greg Abel) og et konstruktivt teknisk setup gør dette til en interessant scout-position, på trods af at stigende renter er en reel modvind for boligtesen.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $142.59 (2x ATR). Sælg hvis boligrentestigningen accelererer yderligere, mold-retssagerne eskalerer til DHI specifikt, eller ved selskabsspecifik indtjeningsskuffelse.

decisions.name: Aflac
decisions.reasoning: 43 år i træk med udbyttestigninger og dyb oversolgt teknik (RSI 25.9) holder tesen intakt trods manglende frisk katalysator denne uge.
bull: 43 consecutive years of dividend growth puts Aflac within reach of 'Dividend King' status, an elite quality signal.
Deeply oversold (RSI 25.9) within a longer-term uptrend (still above its 200-day average).
bear: No fresh company-specific catalyst this week; the setup depends on read-across from peer Globe Life's health-insurance strength.
Momentum has been soft, down nearly 10% over the past month.

investment_plan.thesis: Sektor-bred renteudløst selloff giver en dybt oversolgt entry i et kvalitetsforsikringsselskab med 43 år i træk med udbyttestigninger, stadig over 200-dages gennemsnittet.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $111.84 (2x ATR). Sælg hvis rentepresset på forsikringssektoren viser sig strukturelt vedvarende, eller ved selskabsspecifik indtjeningsskuffelse.

decisions.name: TJX Companies
decisions.reasoning: Hammer-reversal-candle og opadgående estimatrevisioner efter ekstrem oversolgt niveau (RSI 14.3) bekræfter en troværdig bounce-case — Ross Stores' stærke comps understøtter sektortesen.
bull: Extremely oversold (RSI 14.3, Stoch 1.4) with a hammer reversal candle and upward earnings-estimate revisions.
Wall Street consensus firmly rates the stock a Buy.
bear: Still in a confirmed short-term downtrend, roughly 10% below both the 50- and 200-day averages.
Recent momentum remains negative (-7.5% over five days) heading into the reversal setup.

investment_plan.thesis: Beat-and-raise-kvartal overskygget af et isoleret Marmaxx-udførelsesproblem giver en dybt oversolgt entry i en fundamentalt sund off-price-leder, bekræftet af Ross Stores' stærke comps.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $133.58 (2x ATR). Sælg hvis Marmaxx-udførelsesproblemerne eskalerer yderligere eller ved bredere off-price-efterspørgselssvækkelse.

decisions.name: Freeport-McMoRan
decisions.reasoning: Bekræftet breakout på kobber-/AI-datacenter-efterspørgsel, men ekstremt overkøbt (RSI 70.4, pris over øvre Bollinger-bånd) efter en 30%-rally på 20 dage — kun 1 dag i porteføljen, ingen ny handling.
bull: Confirmed breakout to new highs on strong copper/materials demand, with IBD flagging a cleared buy point alongside Palantir.
Materials broadly seen as a sector that outperforms if the Fed hikes rates further.
bear: Extremely overbought (RSI 70.4, Stochastic 99.8, price well above the upper Bollinger Band) after a 30% run in twenty days.
Commentary notes the stock diversifies returns more than risk, i.e., its swings remain large and correlated to copper prices.

investment_plan.thesis: Bekræftet teknisk opadgående trend i kobber på strukturel AI-datacenter-efterspørgsel, samtidig med at det diversificerer porteføljen ud af de tunge Industrials/Financials-sektorer og ind i Materials, som porteføljen ikke har eksponering mod i dag.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $72.17 (2x ATR). Sælg ved skarp reversal uden opfølgning eller hvis AI-capex/kobbertemaet svækkes fundamentalt.
